web.named_query: ("Paul Dabbar" OR "Noah Jaffe") AI artificial intelligence superintelligence policy statements

summary.text: On May 1, 2025, Dabbar described broad opportunities for AI across industries and argued that restricting development would impede productivity and Americans' welfare. In his May 2025 pre-confirmation statements, he pledged support for continued AI model testing, NIST's sharing of results, and AI standards development. As Deputy Secretary of Commerce in December 2025, he promoted AI investment as a way to strengthen American manufacturing competitiveness.

The supplied 2023 source context clarifies the government-adoption recommendation as focused on energy-related regulatory processes; it does not establish an additional general stance.
